hodl_btc.name: Buy & Hold BTC (benchmark)
hodl_btc.thesis: The bar every active strategy must beat after fees.

momentum_rotation.name: Dual momentum rotation (top 3 of 8)
momentum_rotation.thesis: Weekly rotation into the strongest coins; cash if nothing is rising.

memo.why: All coins down over 14 days at last check (best: LINK -4.9%); next check in 13h

dca_btc.name: Daily DCA into BTC (30 days)
dca_btc.thesis: Drip the $100 in about $3 a day. Lump sum vs DCA, settled with data.

crash_buyer.name: Crash buyer (BTC, buys in thirds)
crash_buyer.thesis: Contrarian: buys 15/25/35% drawdowns, sells on recovery.

memo.why: BTC 32% below 60d high $87,249; holding 3/3, sells at $83,027

trw_tpi.name: TRW style TPI trend (BTC)
trw_tpi.thesis: 8 trend indicators vote; long BTC while the average is positive.

memo.why: TPI -0.75 (long while > 0). Bullish: MACD>signal. Key levels: EMA21 $65,153, 20d midpoint $65,600, SMA50 $74,243

trw_box.name: TRW style box breakout (BTC/ETH/SOL)
trw_box.thesis: Buy consolidation breakouts in uptrends, 3% account risk per trade.

memo.why: BTC needs close > box top $76,152.43 + uptrend (>50SMA, EMA9>21) + tighter box; ETH needs close > box top $2,248.41 + uptrend (>50SMA, EMA9>21) + tighter box; SOL needs close > box top $90.56 + uptrend (>50SMA, EMA9>21) + tighter box

crt_btc.name: CRT (Candle Range Theory) on BTC
crt_btc.thesis: Sweep of a candle's range, rejection, then trade back through it. Resting orders.

memo.why: Waiting: last 4H range $58,872 to $59,520. Needs a sweep below $58,872 that closes back inside

ml_predictor.name: AI predictor (8 coins, hourly)
ml_predictor.thesis: ML model predicts win/loss odds every hour; trades only when the edge beats fees. TP/SL on every trade.

memo.why: Predicting every hour, NOT trading: the walk-forward backtest has not found a threshold that beats fees yet

quick_trader.name: Quick 1h long/short (AI + CRT, perp-style)
quick_trader.thesis: Every hour bets for OR against each coin for the next hour when expected value beats fees. Stop-loss and take-profit on every trade.

memo.why: Predicting long/short odds every hour, NOT trading: research found no edge after costs yet

vol_target.name: Volatility targeted trend (BTC+ETH)
vol_target.thesis: 8 year lab winner on risk: hold BTC/ETH only while rising, size down when volatile. 40% CAGR, 46% max DD since 2019.

trend_sma50.name: Trend: BTC above 50 day SMA
trend_sma50.thesis: 8 year lab best return: 52% CAGR, Sharpe 1.17, positive in all 9 parameter variants.

memo.why: Waiting for a daily close above the 50d avg $74,243 (BTC needs +24.0%)

donchian.name: Turtle breakout 20/10 (BTC+ETH)
donchian.thesis: Classic breakout system: 37% CAGR, 47% max DD over 8 years.

memo.why: BTC needs close > 20d high $76,152.43 (+27.2%); ETH needs close > 20d high $2,248.41 (+35.4%)

lev_trend_2x.name: Trend SMA50 at 2x leverage
lev_trend_2x.thesis: Best 8 year growth of any setting: $100 -> $8,900 (vs $2,500 at 1x). Worst drop about 85%.

lev_vol_3x.name: Vol target at 3x leverage
lev_vol_3x.thesis: 8 years: $100 -> $4,600 (vs $1,400 at 1x). Volatility sizing keeps 3x survivable.

lev_btc_10x.name: LOTTERY: BTC at 10x leverage
lev_btc_10x.thesis: Demonstration only. Doubles in 11% of weeks, but every 10x account was liquidated within 8 years.

donchian.name: Turtle breakout 20/10 (BTC+ETH)
donchian.thesis: Classic channel breakout. Buys new highs, cuts on new lows.

vol_target.name: Volatility targeted trend (BTC+ETH)
vol_target.thesis: Trend filter plus risk sizing: smaller positions when markets are wild.

trend_sma50.name: Trend: BTC above 50 day SMA
trend_sma50.thesis: Time series momentum. Rides bull runs, sits in cash during crashes.

memo.why: Waiting for a daily close above the 50d avg $78,578 (BTC needs +24.8%)

ema_cross_6h.name: EMA 9/21 crossover (ETH 6h)
ema_cross_6h.thesis: Faster momentum signal, similar to MACD. More trades, reacts quicker.

memo.why: Buys if a 6h candle closes above $2,196 (+30.5% from here)

rsi_reversion.name: RSI dip buyer (BTC 1h)
rsi_reversion.thesis: Short term mean reversion: buys oversold hours in any market, 6% stop.

bollinger.name: Bollinger band reversion (SOL 1h)
bollinger.thesis: Buys statistically stretched drops on a volatile coin.

memo.why: Waiting for an hourly close below $65.39 (-7.2% from here)

grid_eth.name: Grid trader (ETH ±10%)
grid_eth.thesis: Profits from chop: buys every dip level, sells every rip level.

memo.why: Grid $1,392 to $1,702, 1/10 levels filled; next buy $1,640, next sell $1,702
